pieces.title: The Votes Are the Job
pieces.summary: Why it is fair, and necessary, for Ellen Paul's campaign to make this race about Rep. Steve Weir's record. An incumbent starts with the title on the ballot, a caucus web page, and state-paid newsletters; what he carries that a challenger does not is two terms of recorded votes. Asking voters to read them is not a smear, it is the job review. Written by the co-chair of the Andover Democratic Town Committee, who says so up front, with every figure sourced to the official roll calls.
